shared_elements: quadruped or animal body shown in profile
vertical composition on an upright slab-like surface
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry animal or animal-derived bodies in profile relief on an upright field, which is about as generic as figural carving gets. A shows a composite bird-headed winged anthropomorph with raised hand and bucket among elaborate flowering plants beneath a dense band of inscription, all in fine linear low relief; B shows a stripped-down, near-featureless quadruped in bold projecting relief descending head-downward above a flatter crouching quadruped, with no plants, no human elements and no inscription.
